items.title: 67296_Chauncey Morehouse oral history interview
items.q: Well I write with Irving Mills. ... So everything that I'd write, I'd take right down to Irving Mills.

ctx.x: Now you made - I was with Irving Mills who had Master Records was the name of it. That was it and then Variety was their 35¢ label.
Well I write with Irving Mills.
Oh you did. Under what circumstances?
